theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_uce_unimodular_iff_unit_coord
theorems.statement: ∀ (p a : ℕ), p.Prime → 0 < a → ∀ r s : ZMod (p ^ a), (∃ x y : ZMod (p ^ a), x * r + y * s = 1) ↔ IsUnit r ∨ IsUnit s
